text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's prime minister welcomes Prince Charles' visit to Bahrain, where he is due to arrive on Monday.

- Municipality raises taxes for all industrial and many commercial establishments in Bahrain. The new rates, which take immediate effect, could mean an increase of up to 4,000 percent on taxes paid by some businesses.
- National Bank of Bahrain's net profit grows 31 percent in 1996.
- Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company to be is registered on the Bahrain Stock Exchange after increasing its capital to two million dinars.
- Bahrain plans three industrial and services projects at a cost of $3 billion in the next four years.
